thread:
alexa: quick idea - build a tiny 'deploy-assist' wrapper so teams don't have to remember 8 flags every release. make dry-run default and produce a release digest + rollback bookmark.

morgan: sounds useful. what does the digest include?

alexa: minimal: resolved image SHAs, manifest diff (k8s + infra), list of migrations, change-window, pins applied, and smoke-run summary. store digest in S3 and link to Console.

tia: dry-run default is smart. we still need a one-click 'promote' to actually deploy. can we do that from Console?

alexa: yes - CLI creates a small state doc in a k8s configmap and a Console action appears: Promote / Abort / View Digest.

ops-bot: reminder: we already have @ops-bot force-commit and abort actions. wrapper should call those under the hood when operator clicks promote/abort.

alexa: example UX: dev does `deploy-assist start --version v3.2.0 --notes "perf fixes"` -> wrapper resolves manifests, runs dry-run (helm diff / terraform plan), runs smoke matrix in GH action, then emits a release digest URL and waits. Promote calls `/deploy-bot apply --pin=sha:... --mode=hard`.

morgan: clever. how about rollback bookmarks? sometimes the previous 'good' SHA isn't the immediate previous.

alexa: wrapper will record a rollback bookmark on successful canary + stable commit. command: `deploy-assist bookmark --name stable-2026-03-19 --sha abc123`. then promote can reference `--rollback-to=bookmark:stable-2026-03-19`.

tia: DB migration concern again. allow `--manual-gate` for releases that need human verification before promote.

alexa: yes. behavior: if manifest contains migration hooks or `migrations:` key, wrapper auto-sets manual-gate unless `--allow-auto` is passed and reviewed. also allow per-team Console toggle to prefer manual gating.

devops: how do we run smoke matrix? anything new or call existing suites?

alexa: call existing suites in parallel but with timeouts tuned for release-assist (shorter). GH action runs smoke, e2e-lite, and health pings. failures fail the dry-run and add a 'blocked' tag to digest. wrapper then posts an ops thread with suggested rollback bookmark if previous bookmark exists.

morgan: pin modes? soft vs hard vs canary?

alexa: yep - `--pin-mode` with values [soft, hard, canary]. default hard in prod, canary in staging. canary does staged rollout and pins only in control plane.

ops-bot: small note: ensure wrapper respects existing safety windows from the calendar service. do not override.

alexa: agreed - wrapper queries Calendar API for team windows and aborts if outside. we also show a 'schedule' flag to auto-schedule the promote within the next window.

morgan: can we include a tiny release-note template generator? teams forget sections.

alexa: simple template with fields: version, summary, risks, migration, rollout, rollback-bookmark, links. CLI populates fields from manifest and gives editors a pre-filled markdown file saved to S3.

tia: great. one more ops ask: surface an 'escape hatch' that runs rollback to a named bookmark and posts to #incidents automatically.

alexa: built-in: `deploy-assist emergency-rollback --to bookmark:stable-2026-03-19 --annotate "ops-rollback"` -> calls release-bot /deploy rollback and pings oncall.

devops: timeline? I can review the GH action and smoke-run config once PR is up.

alexa: planning PR tomorrow with a Go CLI + GH action for smoke. demo Wed. staging roll after review.

morgan: please add runbook snippets for long migrations and the manual-gate flow.

alexa: will add runbook + Console toggle for per-team auto-rollback. thanks y'all. :raised_hands:
